scope: Conditional mechanical and cooling requirements for tiled membrane/cassette alternatives. No radiation-damaged film lifetime or sealed pressure-vessel qualification.

silica.property_scope: Bulk room-temperature Corning k/E/nu; 10MPa is a required allowable for actual film, not measured hot irradiated strength.

carbon.property_scope: Controlled in-plane graphite k100 scenario. E50GPa bulk Pyroid reference; nu.2 and alpha1ppm are scenario values, actual anisotropy and irradiation require qualification.

BN.property_scope: Momentive bulk in-plane k60. E30GPa and nu.2 scenario only; no hot-film strength implied.

SiC.property_scope: Saint-Gobain bulk k at1000C and E atRT, CTE to1100C; nu.17 controlled scenario. 10MPa remains film requirement.

pressure_closure_rows.scope: Opposing pressure forces must close locally. Tile edges alone do not remove global shell load; buckling, seals, attachments and thermal distortion omitted from mass floor.
